title: Report cards over time: each student's scores by run, a slip shown before demotion
request: Phase 7 (the owner): every student watched as it learns; 29.14: report cards over time.
plan: Read the register's own history back per point.
Flag a student whose dev score fell, or whose exam turned, since its last run.
Show it on the Students tab.

decisions.decision: A slip is shown, never acted on here.
decisions.why: Demotion is the routing's audited switch; the page warns the owner first.

change: students.history and SLIP; /api/students carries the history; the Students tab draws the last scores and a slipping pill.
outcome: The owner sees each student's scores over its runs and a slip before any demotion fires.
lessons: Keep every run of a register: the history is the report card, and it costs one line a run.
risks: The register is written when someone runs it: a nightly run is 29.7's.
